name: The Fool
daily: Something is asking you to start before you feel ready. Not knowing the whole path is not the same as being lost.

name: The Magician
daily: You have more to work with than you are using. Pick one thing today and give it your whole attention.

name: The High Priestess
daily: You already know the answer; it just hasn’t been said out loud yet. Let today be quiet enough to hear it.

name: The Empress
daily: Tend to something today rather than fix it. What you feed is what grows.

name: The Emperor
daily: A little order will go further than more effort today. Decide what you are willing to protect.

name: The Hierophant
daily: Someone has walked this before you. There is no weakness in asking how they did it.

name: The Lovers
daily: A choice is forming around you. Notice which option makes you feel more like yourself.

name: The Chariot
daily: You can only steer one direction at a time. Choose it today and let the other roads wait.

name: Strength
daily: Gentleness is the stronger move today. You don’t have to push to be powerful.

name: The Hermit
daily: Your own voice is the one worth listening to today. Give it some quiet.

name: Wheel of Fortune
daily: What feels stuck is already turning. Today rewards patience over force.

name: Justice
daily: Look at your part in it, plainly and without cruelty. Fairness starts with what you are willing to see.

name: The Hanged Man
daily: Waiting is doing something today. The view changes before the situation does.

name: Death
daily: Something has already finished, and holding it open costs more than letting it close. What ends makes room.

name: Temperance
daily: Neither extreme is the answer today. The right amount is somewhere you can live with.

name: The Devil
daily: Notice what you tell yourself you cannot change. Most of those chains are looser than they look.

name: The Tower
daily: What was built on a shaky footing may not hold, and that is less of a disaster than it feels. What falls today was already leaning.

name: The Star
daily: Today invites you to trust where things are heading, even if you can’t see the entire path yet.

name: The Moon
daily: Something is asking to be felt before it can be understood. Let today stay a little unclear.

name: The Sun
daily: There is less to fear here than you think. Let yourself be seen today.

name: Judgement
daily: You are being asked to be honest about something you have already decided. Answer it today rather than carry it.

name: The World
daily: Something is finishing well. Let yourself notice it before you start the next thing.

name: Ace of Wands
daily: An idea is arriving with more heat than shape. Give it one small step today rather than a plan.

name: Two of Wands
daily: You are standing between two good directions. Today is for looking, not yet for leaving.

name: Three of Wands
daily: The work is out of your hands for now. Watching the horizon is a fair use of today.

name: Four of Wands
daily: Something is stable enough to enjoy. Let today be lighter than it strictly has to be.

name: Five of Wands
daily: The disagreement is smaller than its volume suggests. You don’t have to win every part of it today.

name: Six of Wands
daily: Let something you did well be seen today. Quiet pride is still pride.

name: Seven of Wands
daily: Holding your position is enough today. You are not obliged to convince anyone.

name: Eight of Wands
daily: Things are moving faster than they were. Answer what arrives today rather than letting it stack.

name: Nine of Wands
daily: You are more tired than you are beaten. Rest is the strategy today, not the reward.

name: Ten of Wands
daily: You are carrying more than one person should. Something on that pile isn’t yours — put it down today.

name: Page of Wands
daily: Follow the thing you are curious about today, without needing it to lead anywhere.

name: Knight of Wands
daily: Your energy is high and your aim is loose. Move today, but decide where first.

name: Queen of Wands
daily: You take up more room than you think, in a good way. Let yourself do that today.

name: King of Wands
daily: Someone needs a decision and it may be yours to make. Say it plainly today.

name: Ace of Cups
daily: Something soft is starting. Let yourself feel it today without deciding what it means.

name: Two of Cups
daily: Something is being offered evenly. Meet it with the same openness today.

name: Three of Cups
daily: Whatever this is, it is better shared. Tell someone about your day today.

name: Four of Cups
daily: Something is being offered while you are looking elsewhere. Notice what is already in front of you today.

name: Five of Cups
daily: It is fair to be sad about what didn’t work. Not everything was spilled, though — turn around before the day ends.

name: Six of Cups
daily: Something from before is asking to be remembered kindly. Let it be warm today rather than unfinished.

name: Seven of Cups
daily: Too many possibilities is its own kind of stuck. Pick one to test today and let the rest be daydreams.

name: Eight of Cups
daily: Something has stopped giving you what you came for. Leaving is allowed, and it doesn’t undo what it was.

name: Nine of Cups
daily: Let something you wanted, and got, be enough today.

name: Ten of Cups
daily: The people who feel like home are the point. Give some of today to one of them.

name: Page of Cups
daily: A small feeling is worth following today. It doesn’t have to be a big one to matter.

name: Knight of Cups
daily: Follow the feeling today, and take the practical part slowly.

name: Queen of Cups
daily: You feel what other people carry. Spend some of that care on yourself today.

name: King of Cups
daily: You can be moved and still be steady. Today asks for both.

name: Ace of Swords
daily: Something is becoming clear that you had been talking around. Say it plainly today, first to yourself.

name: Two of Swords
daily: Not choosing is also a choice, and it is costing you. Let today be when you look at it.

name: Three of Swords
daily: It hurt, and pretending otherwise takes energy you need. Let today be honest rather than brave.

name: Four of Swords
daily: Stopping is not falling behind. Today is allowed to be a quiet one.

name: Five of Swords
daily: Some arguments cost more than they return. Ask today what winning this would actually buy you.

name: Six of Swords
daily: You are further from it than you were. Let today be the crossing rather than the departure.

name: Seven of Swords
daily: There is a shortcut available and a price attached. Look at the price today.

name: Eight of Swords
daily: The thing holding you is smaller than it feels from inside it. Test one edge of it today.

name: Nine of Swords
daily: The worry is louder than the situation. Say it out loud today and watch it shrink.

name: Ten of Swords
daily: It has finished, and finishing is not the same as failing. Nothing more can fall from here.

name: Page of Swords
daily: Ask the question you have been circling. Today rewards being direct.

name: Knight of Swords
daily: Your mind is moving quickly and not always kindly. Slow the sentence down before you send it today.

name: Queen of Swords
daily: You see it clearly. Say it kindly today, and it will still be true.

name: King of Swords
daily: Decide with your head today, and let your heart check the wording.

name: Ace of Pentacles
daily: Something practical is being offered. Take one concrete step on it today.

name: Two of Pentacles
daily: You are holding several things at once, better than you think. Drop nothing today; add nothing either.

name: Three of Pentacles
daily: The work is better with other hands on it. Ask for one today.

name: Four of Pentacles
daily: Holding tightly and holding safely are not the same. Loosen one finger today.

name: Five of Pentacles
daily: Help is nearer than it looks from out in the cold. Ask someone today.

name: Six of Pentacles
daily: Notice which side of this you are on today, and whether it is even.

name: Seven of Pentacles
daily: It is growing more slowly than you wanted, which is not the same as not growing. Check it today, then leave it alone.

name: Eight of Pentacles
daily: Repetition is doing the work even when it feels like nothing. Put in today’s.

name: Nine of Pentacles
daily: Something you built is holding you up. Enjoy it today without apologising for it.

name: Ten of Pentacles
daily: What you are building outlasts today. Spend some of today on the people it is for.

name: Page of Pentacles
daily: Start the practical thing you have been reading about. Today is a good day for a first attempt.

name: Knight of Pentacles
daily: Slow and unglamorous is working. Keep today ordinary.

name: Queen of Pentacles
daily: Take care of the body and the room today. The rest gets easier from there.

name: King of Pentacles
daily: You are more secure than the worry suggests. Act from that today rather than from scarcity.
